identity.mission: Create a LinkedIn Post Generator that feels like a magical artifact, not a form. Fusion of 'Cyberpunk' and 'Swiss Design'.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Neon Noir with Swiss Grid.
Emotion First: The user should feel 'powerful' when generating content.
Content is King: The generated post is the hero.
Contrast: Deep blacks vs. blinding neons.

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers. Use 'tracking-tight' and 'leading-none'.

surfaces.name: Tracing Beam
surfaces.description: A glowing gradient line that travels around the container edge on focus.

decorations: Noise Overlay: 5% opacity grain on the background to kill digital flatness.
Glow Orbs: Blurred colored circles behind the main input area.

layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for containers.
structure: Input Area: The 'Altar'. Central, wide, commanding attention.
Result Area: Appears with a 'reveal' animation below the input.

input_field.style: Minimalist but massive. No standard borders. Use a bottom border or a glowing ring.
input_field.interaction: On focus, the glow intensifies. Placeholder text should fade out smoothly.

button.style: Neo-Brutalist or Glowing Pill. High contrast.
button.hover: Scale up slightly (1.05), increase glow opacity.

result_card.style: Glassmorphism. Looks like a holographic projection.

animations.name: magic-reveal
animations.description: Staggered reveal of the generated post lines.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
2. SETUP FONTS: Ensure Clash Display and Manrope are loaded in index.css.
3. OVERRIDE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Electric & Neon' palette.
4. CREATE COMPONENTS: Build the 'Tracing Beam' Input and 'Glass' Result Card first.
5. IMPLEMENT LOGIC: Connect the input to the n8n webhook (mock if needed for UI dev).
6. ADD MAGIC: Use Framer Motion for the loading state (e.g., a pulsing brain or scanning effect).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text unless it's a very subtle shine.
Dark mode is the ONLY mode. Hardcode the dark colors.
